profile.migration_strategy_justification: Normalize legacy lane text into universal lane records, then bind task and chain ownership through their lane foreign-key columns.

invariants: Legacy item, task, and dispatch-chain row counts are unchanged.
Null-like legacy branches remain unassigned; usable task and chain lanes reference one universal lane record.
Terminal, cancelled, and stopped sources use released lane records rather than active ownership.
Divergent path text is rejected for active ownership; fully released branch history is retained without an owning path.
Every active lane role is allowed and every populated lane set satisfies the item's pinned workflow policy.
An active path and an active single-lane role cannot be owned twice.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration is idempotent and leaves path-only historical terminal tasks unassigned. Fully released sources with divergent paths converge on a released lane without an owning path; any active divergence remains a hard refusal. New writes use universal lane references; legacy lane text exists only as migration input.
